title: Spyglass: Officially Launched
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of the powerful Spyglass tool, designed to provide comprehensive and actionable insights for all users.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: We've launched powerful new controls that empower you to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize the display of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Roadmap
summary: Get an exciting, transparent look at our product's past, present, and future with our brand new public roadmap page.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our redesigned checkboxes are now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, making your task management more efficient and enjoyable.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Our latest improvements make working together in the editor more intuitive, visible, and effortless, transforming how you collaborate with your team.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: We've made it incredibly simple to find and engage with all content shared by your collaborators, fostering more connected and productive teamwork.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding to offer comprehensive support for multiple international languages, making it accessible to even more users worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with unparalleled control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Uncover hidden connections and streamline your workflows with powerful new filtering options and shared item visibility in your personalized knowledge constellation.

title: Supercharged Search and Curated Collections
summary: Navigate your knowledge with precision using our enhanced search filters, allowing you to create and save personalized collections of information.

title: Flexible Note Layouts
summary: This feature empowers you to beautifully structure your notes with dynamic layouts, making your content more accessible and interactive.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko with ultimate flexibility through self-hosting options and premium cloud plans tailored to elevate your workflow.

title: Enhanced Themes and New Styles
summary: Get ready for a visual upgrade as we enhance existing themes and bring you a wider selection of fresh, stunning designs.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our app to always greet you with the perfect message, precisely matching the time of day wherever you are for a truly personalized experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Gain greater control over your content by effortlessly managing tagged items directly from the tag list, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, or view their details in one seamless experience.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate a broader spectrum of information, including YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, to consolidate all your valuable knowledge in one powerful place.
